The Return of Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang.

Elon Musk says Nvidia will lose critical deals without Jensen Huang, because many were a handshake, not a contract. A Stand With Jensen petition now has 95,000+ names, including 5,000 self-reported Nvidia employees. Can he actually come back? We go through the board math, his 3.58% stake, and the Wachtell Lipton investigation run by former federal prosecutor Joon Kim. Plus the WSJ report that Jensen called CFO Colette Kress a deer in the headlights over billions in customer backstops.
